BiblicalUsage: The name is Rinnah, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 4:20: "…the sons of Shimon, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rinnah counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
